description: Which large shareholdings in Japanese companies changed recently, across all issuers? One row per large shareholding report read from EDINET, newest first: issuer, holder (corporate names only), total ratio as filed and the previous total stated in it, and event types derived from those figures only: new_stake, increase, decrease, below_5_percent, crossed_up/down (10%, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3), amendment, change_unknown with reason. Unread reports are counted. No assessment of intent.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous answer with the same other inputs, to get the next page

event_types.description: Optional: only rows having at least one of these event types (new_stake, increase, decrease, unchanged, below_5_percent, crossed_up, crossed_down, amendment, change_unknown). Over HTTP, comma-separated

holder.description: Optional EDINET code (E12345) of a holder filed as a corporation: only reports that list it

issuer.description: Optional issuer: EDINET code (E12345) or securities code (4 or 5 characters)

since.description: Only reports submitted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time). Default: 6 days before until. since..until may span at most 31 days

until.description: Only reports submitted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, Japan time). Default: today

name: edinet_ownership_change_events

coverage.description: What this service has indexed: the date range, missing days (backfill in progress) and freshness.

events.description: Newest first; derived from figures as filed; no assessment of intent.

change_points.description: ratio minus ratio_last_report, in percentage points.

name_ja.description: Only for holders filed as corporations (法人).

ratio_last_report.description: The previous report's total as stated in this report.

events_not_built.description: Filings in the range with no event (not read yet, no CSV, unreadable); not silently dropped.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: found; none_in_range (none among reports read so far: see events_not_built); unknown.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Large shareholding changes across issuers (Japan EDINET)
